summary: The agent failed the verifier despite correct logical steps. Root cause: used dict-based ZIP reconstruction (`{name: z.read(name)}`) which strips ZipInfo metadata (timestamps, compression flags, external attributes), producing a structurally different archive. Also spent excessive cycles deliberating when the target value already matched the current value. Updated SKILL.md to add the ZIP repack anti-pattern, enforce the proper ZipInfo-preserving copy pattern, and add a decision rule to always write the file even when values already match.
